name: betway-backend
description: Betway Nigeria backend — Prisma ORM, Express, SQLite

scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps && prisma generate && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.resolve(__dirname,'../');const dst=__dirname;['www.betway.com.ng','cdn.betwayafrica.com','cms1.betwayafrica.com'].forEach(d=>{const s=path.join(src,d),t=path.join(dst,d);if(fs.existsSync(s)&&!fs.existsSync(t)){fs.cpSync(s,t,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied',d);}else if(fs.existsSync(t)){console.log('Already exists',d);}else{console.log('Source not found',s);}});" && node -e "if(process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL){const {execSync}=require('child_process');try{execSync('npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss',{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,DATABASE_URL:process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL}});console.log('Turso schema pushed');}catch(e){console.warn('Turso push warning:',e.message);}}else{console.log('No Turso URL, skipping push');}"
